# 2nd method try to forge our own BSGenome package from T2T-CHM13 NCBI GCF assembly

```{r}

BiocManager::install("BSgenomeForge")
library(BSgenomeForge)

forgeBSgenomeDataPkgFromNCBI(
  assembly_accession = "GCF_009914755.1",
  organism = "Homo sapiens",
  pkg_maintainer = "Stefanus Bernard <s.bernard5@universityofgalway.ie>",
  circ_seqs = character(0)   # The NCBI RefSeq assembly differs from the submitted assembly in the following ways: Removed chromosome MT
)


remotes::install_local("./BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0/")


library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.NCBI.T2TCHM13v2.0)

```
